name: IG Compliance Reporter
description: v1.6: highlights now advance reliably -- verifies each story change and falls back to ArrowRight / tap if the Next arrow isn't found, and flags early stops. v1.5: story highlight links (instagram.com/stories/highlights/<id>) are now accepted instead of skipped as invalid -- each story in the highlight is reported in turn via Next. Step through Instagram post/reel/profile/highlight tabs (already open, or pasted as links) and file a restricted-items (tobacco) report on each, one tab at a time, closing each after a 5s confirmation wait. v1.4: fixed the profile page's '...' menu not being found -- it's labeled just 'Options' there (not 'More options' like on posts) and sits beside the username heading rather than in a normal toolbar; detection now matches that label and checks near the username as well.
